scope: Native starter-plume extraction plus resolved Low impostor and Medium/High actual-axial-publication consumers; this is not complete Bevy retirement or native nozzle-light parity.

contract.ownership: GPL terrain-native owns the provisional starter deck, nozzle station, reference-atmosphere extraction and retained Low optical bake. MIT render-wgpu owns sample/texture transport, unit coverage, independent medium integration and modal shell representation. No GPL game shader or optical bake is relicensed into the MIT backend.
contract.source: One explicit starter X-15 only, from local FlightAuthority or a fresh explicit-starter replica. No arbitrary retained-mesh nozzle inference, pre-snapshot plume, stale-link continuation or renderer-owned simulation clock. Map ownership suppresses extraction without changing engine/throttle.
contract.provisional_deck: Methalox fixture: exit radius 0.55 m, full-flow 480 kg/s, exhaust velocity 3550 m/s, exit pressure 120000 Pa, exit temperature 1850 K, Mach 3.5. Nozzle is craft-space (0,-7.5,0) physical metres independent of mesh scale. Not calibrated X-15 propulsion or compiled nozzle extraction.
contract.profile: 48 CPU stations cached in 2% throttle and logarithmic approximately 2% pressure bands with a 50 Pa floor. This fixes the saturating legacy pressure key. Immutable 32-byte-per-station GPU payloads upload on publication changes only.
contract.quality: Low uses a caller-provided 32x256 sRGB optical bake on a 32-sector unit cone. Medium/High integrate the same station radius/extinction/emission/shock with 8/14 samples. Tangent-warped bins concentrate the fixed budget near thin local slices of the vacuum bound and retain each bin's physical path length.
contract.transport: Conservative projected finite-cylinder-box coverage, with near-plane/inside fallback; exact axial and camera-inside rays are supported. One active color-load pass samples existing stored scene depth and truncates the integral even at an opaque hit inside the field. No depth copy/writes, fitted mean extinction/hues, hard skirt clip, parallel-ray rejection or near-camera opacity fudge.
contract.animation: Low retains game-owned cone flicker. Native volume shell modes are independently implemented, zero-mean and advected with simulation time; flicker=false removes shell deformation. The last 30% axial dissolve is representation detail. Neither alters simulation state; the numerical central-chord oracle excludes these residual details.
contract.disabled: Disabled clears the producer and drops GPU resources. No-source frames never allocate a consumer. An inactive retained consumer records no pass or uploads. No timestamp queries exist outside opt-in measurement.
contract.resource_bound: Per allocated consumer: two pipelines, 160-byte camera + 80-byte draw buffers, a 2048-byte station buffer, a 32768-byte impostor and 192 unit-cone vertices. Active volume writes 240 frame bytes; profile changes upload 48*32 bytes. Draw/march/upload counters are workload counters, not visibility counts or GPU time.
contract.capture: native-topology-v6-plume keeps the existing interval names and explicitly includes the plume pass in render.scene_classify_and_raster. Requested/resolved settings remain recorded; native_plume_light_applied=false and native_plume_light_status=unavailable prevent a false lighting claim.
contract.lighting: Native engine_plume.light is explicitly unavailable. The old field-derived point light remains a retirement obligation to integrate through existing shared lighting/RT, not a second generic light subsystem. No light parity is claimed.

verification.status: All 27 command gates passed. 606 non-configuration inputs stayed byte-identical; graphics.toml changed comments only, with parsed TOML equality verified against the tested baseline. No remote CI claim.
verification.hardware: AMD Radeon 880M Graphics / RADV STRIX1 / Vulkan / Mesa 26.2.4-arch1.1
verification.focused: Portable naga validation; GPU slab/profile/axial/inside/depth/camera/upload/lifecycle tests; release CLI Low/Medium/High/disabled captures with identical final authoritative flight telemetry and silent audio.

python3 tools/agent-qa/check_architecture.py; python3 -m unittest discover -s tools/agent-qa/tests -v; git diff --check (separate command gates)

Inherited focused map/flight/mouse/visibility/flyby/maneuver/performance regressions and muted window smokes, plus cargo test --release -p thessa-terrain-native --bin thessa-terrain-native plume:: -- --nocapture --test-threads=1 and thessa-terrain-native --hud --flight --throttle 0.5 --frames 8 --mute; exact argv in gates.json

diagnostics.gpu_fixture: One source, 1280x720, 4 warmups and 32 samples; actual command timestamps, isolated consumer fixture, not total scene cost
diagnostics.cpu_fixture: One source, 48 stations, 20000 release iterations; cached extraction versus forced profile rebuild
diagnostics.cli_boundary: 320x180, two measured frames after warmup, actual local flight at throttle 0.5 and 0.025 s admission, silent audio; all four final authoritative telemetry strings identical. Async terrain residency varies, so pixel counts establish contribution, not stable image identity or preference.

numeric_bounds.boundary: Undeformed untapered central chords compared with 256-step CPU integration over the same bounded chord; radiometric normalization avoids SDR clipping masking vacuum errors. Not a universal animated/oblique/tail-view error bound.

verification.preliminary_diagnostics: The first final-chain invocation passed gates 0-6 but hit the shell timeout during release build. Its outputs are retained in target/test-tmp/native-plume-before-metadata; graphics/capture metadata and offscreen-coverage regression were completed before the fresh unbounded stable-source run. Earlier debug GPU and focused CLI logs remain in target/test-tmp/plume-*.log.

limitations: No native field-derived nozzle light, compiled/nozzle-count extraction, crosswind, condensation, secondary combustion, surface impingement, wake or adaptive residual field
Finite radial integration bound is 1.6 times the largest station radius; full-view animated/tapered transport error is not certified by the central-chord fixtures
No independent blind visual/usability acceptance, OS-level key injection, Metal/WebGPU execution or remote CI claim
No whole-client performance win or complete Bevy retirement: remaining guidance/target inputs, docking/contact inspection, optics/material producers and packaging/tooling still need replacement
